gbrain connectors — sync your own AI-assistant chat history into the brain

Live sync of ChatGPT + Claude conversation history using your own session
credential. Cookie paste-in is the primary lane. (For the manual export-file
lane, see the conversation-archive skill / `gbrain transcripts ingest`.)

Subcommands:
  auth <provider>       Store a session credential and verify it.

rows.name: publish
rows.rustExcerpt:
Usage: gbrain publish <page.md> [--password ["secret"]] [--title "Title"] [--out path]

  Generates a shareable HTML page from brain markdown.
  Strips private data (frontmatter, citations, timeline, brain links).
  Optionally encrypts with AES-256-GCM (client-side, no server needed).

  --password          Auto-generate a password
  --password "secret" Use a specific password
  --title "Title"     Override the page title
  --out path          Output file (default: <input-basename>.html)
